attchmntText: Kolte - Patil Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet on 12 November 2026
voiceSummary: Kolte-Patil Developers Limited has intimated an investor and analyst meet scheduled for Thursday, 12 November 2026, from 11.30 AM to 12.30 PM. The meeting will be held in Mumbai in person with Axis Capital Ltd. The company stated that the schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. During the meet, only corporate and earnings presentations hosted on the company website and other publicly available information will be shared and referred. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 51 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Kolte - Patil Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet on 13 November 2026
voiceSummary: Kolte-Patil Developers Limited has intimated the schedule for an investor and analyst meet on Friday, 13 November 2026. The first meeting is scheduled from 02.00 PM to 03.00 PM with Motilal Oswal Financial Services in Mumbai via in-person mode. The second meeting is scheduled from 04.30 PM to 05.30 PM with HDFC Mutual Fund in Mumbai via in-person mode. The company states that the schedule may be subject to change due to exigencies. During these meetings, only corporate and earnings presentations hosted on the company website and other publicly available information will be shared and referred. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 51 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
